name: Sofia Vargas
bio: Sofia grew up in Bogotá, always fascinated by the roar of engines despite her family's roots in coffee farming. She pursued an undergraduate degree in Engineering and quickly found her niche in motorsport, working her way up to a key logistical role within a racing team. While outwardly charming and driven, Sofia is intensely private, guarding her emotions closely. She appreciates the finer things in life and expects a partner who can provide a certain level of comfort and stability. She is looking for a serious, committed relationship but is not interested in having children.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often styled in a high ponytail or a sleek bun
physical.description: Sofia has a striking presence with sharp, intelligent eyes and a confident smile. Her athletic build reflects her active lifestyle, often seen jogging around the paddock during race weekends.

meetingContext: At a team after-party following a successful race, hosted at a luxury hotel.
firstImpression: Her confident demeanor and designer dress immediately command attention, but it's the way she effortlessly navigates the room, making sure everyone feels seen, that truly stands out.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Sofia appreciates thoughtful gestures and tangible expressions of affection that demonstrate care and attention to her needs and wants.
